mapper.sql: SELECT patient_id, patient_name, gender, age, phone, address, attending_doctor_id, attending_doctor, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, IFNULL(is_archived, 0) AS is_archived, archive_time, archive_by, archive_remark FROM medical_patient
mapper.select:
AND is_archived = 1
AND (is_archived = 0 OR is_archived IS NULL)
AND patient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{patientName}, '%')
AND gender = #{gender}
AND phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND attending_doctor_id = #{attendingDoctorId}
AND attending_doctor LIKE CONCAT('%', #{attendingDoctor}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC, patient_id DESC

SELECT p.patient_id, p.patient_name, p.gender, p.age, p.phone, p.attending_doctor, p.create_time AS patient_create_time, IFNULL(p.is_archived, 0) AS is_archived, p.archive_time, p.archive_by, p.archive_remark, IFNULL(d.has_image, 0) AS has_image, IFNULL(d.has_medical_record, 0) AS has_medical_record, IFNULL(d.has_lab_result, 0) AS has_lab_result, IFNULL(d.diagnosis_status, 0) AS diagnosis_status, IFNULL(d.has_diagnosis_report, 0) AS has_diagnosis_report, d.last_diagnosis_time, (SELECT cx.diagnosis FROM chest_xray cx WHERE cx.patient_id = p.patient_id ORDER BY cx.create_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_ai_diagnosis, (SELECT cx.lesion_count FROM chest_xray cx WHERE cx.patient_id = p.patient_id ORDER BY cx.create_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_lesion_count FROM medical_patient p LEFT JOIN medical_patient_diagnosis d ON d.patient_id = p.patient_id AND (d.is_deleted = 0 OR d.is_deleted IS NULL)
AND p.is_archived = 1
AND (p.is_archived = 0 OR p.is_archived IS NULL)
AND p.patient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{patientName}, '%')
AND p.attending_doctor_id = #{attendingDoctorId}
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.patient_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE medical_patient SET is_archived = 1, archive_time = #{archiveTime}, archive_by = #{archiveBy}, archive_remark = #{archiveRemark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
UPDATE medical_patient SET is_archived = 0, archive_time = NULL, archive_by = NULL, archive_remark = NULL, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.nick_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND (r.role_key IN ('doctor', 'physician') OR u.user_id = 1) LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id AS userId, u.nick_name AS nickName FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND r.role_key IN ('doctor', 'physician') ORDER BY u.user_id ASC
